01 · Embedded Web Control

ESP32 Web Server

A hands-on IoT learning project focused on using an ESP32 as a local web server and controlling connected devices through a browser-based interface.

01 · Overview

Project Overview

The ESP32 Web Server project explores how a microcontroller can provide a local web interface for controlling connected hardware.

The project combines embedded programming, networking fundamentals and hardware control into a single IoT workflow.

02 · Concepts

Concepts Learned

  • ESP32 microcontroller programming
  • Local web server concepts
  • HTTP request and response flow
  • Browser-based device control
  • Embedded C / Arduino IDE workflow
03 · System Design

System Architecture

Browser → Wi-Fi Network → ESP32 Web Server → GPIO Control → Connected Device

The ESP32 acts as the central embedded controller. A user can access the web interface from a device connected to the same local network.

04 · Hardware & Software

Tools Used

  • ESP32 development board
  • Arduino IDE
  • Embedded C / Arduino programming
  • Wi-Fi connectivity
  • Browser-based web interface
05 · Setup

Setup & Wiring

The ESP32 is connected to the required output device and programmed through the Arduino IDE. After connecting the ESP32 to the local network, the web server can be accessed through its local network address.

06 · Implementation

Implementation

The Arduino program initializes the ESP32, connects it to the configured Wi-Fi network, starts the web server and handles browser requests.

When a control action is selected from the browser interface, the ESP32 processes the request and changes the corresponding GPIO state.

07 · Configuration

Configuration

The project requires the appropriate ESP32 board configuration in Arduino IDE and the required network credentials before uploading the program.

08 · Evidence

Project Evidence

09 · Challenges & Fixes

Challenges & Fixes

Understanding the communication between the browser interface and the ESP32 was an important part of the learning process.

Debugging the embedded program and checking network connectivity helped identify and resolve issues during implementation.

10 · Reflection

What I Learned

This project helped build a practical understanding of how embedded controllers can interact with web interfaces and how IoT systems connect software control with physical hardware.
